currency_rule: Display monetary values in the currency returned by the SWFI record; do not synthesize conversions. AUM ranking rows must include currency and as-of date when disclosed by SWFI.

freshness_rules.live: Fetched from same-origin backend at render time with no-store client fetches.
freshness_rules.static: Source-parity brand/page copy in the repository; not used for dashboard facts.
freshness_rules.blocked: Not accepted until an approved source contract or endpoint exists.

modules.label: Total Institutions Tracked
modules.data_source: SWFI production Mongo mirror entity records
modules.query_rule: Read dashboard metrics card `institutions` from the backend metrics packet.
modules.calculation_rule: Backend count of approved production entity records.
modules.duplicate_rule: Entity count is unique by backend entity record.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com; do not infer from frontend constants.
modules.approved_business_logic: Card value must be returned as a factual SWFI packet.

modules.label: Active Allocators / Top Active Investors
modules.data_source: Completed SWFI transaction rows grouped by buyer/acquirer entity.
modules.query_rule: Use completed transactions in the selected 90-day window; derive rankings from buyer/acquirer side only.
modules.calculation_rule: Group by buyer/acquirer entity; count deals; sum disclosed deal values; keep latest transaction date.
modules.duplicate_rule: Transactions may count for multiple buyers only when the source row lists multiple buyer/acquirer entities.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com or an empty table; never show historical out-of-window rows as active.
modules.approved_business_logic: The BDO 2024 issue remains blocked by requiring completed buyer/acquirer transactions inside the selected window.

modules.label: Recent Transactions / Newest Transactions / Recent Deals
modules.query_rule: Use transaction activity date within the selected period; expose buyer/acquirer and source URL for internal routing.
modules.calculation_rule: Sort by transaction activity date descending. Deal value displays only when disclosed by SWFI.
modules.duplicate_rule: A transaction appears once per transaction record in transaction/deal lists.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com or an empty table when no factual rows are available.
modules.approved_business_logic: Rows must not appear merely because a non-business timestamp changed.

modules.label: Live RFPs / Mandates / Recently Fundraising
modules.data_source: SWFI Compass opportunity, RFP, and mandate records.
modules.query_rule: Return open Compass rows with due date on or after the current date.
modules.calculation_rule: Count and list open RFP/mandate rows; display disclosed deadline, strategy, region, and internal detail route.
modules.duplicate_rule: One row per Compass source record.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com or an empty table.
modules.approved_business_logic: Expired mandates must not count as live.

modules.label: Market Activity / Sector Flow
modules.data_source: SWFI transaction rows grouped by sector, region, and industry.
modules.query_rule: Use transaction rows in the selected 365-day activity window grouped by normalized sector fields.
modules.calculation_rule: Count rows and sum disclosed capital by facet; undisclosed values remain Not disclosed by SWFI.com.
modules.duplicate_rule: A transaction may appear in one sector facet and one region facet; cross-category duplication is intentional and documented.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com rather than illustrative market-flow values.
modules.approved_business_logic: Do not generate sector flows from report copy or LLM summaries.

modules.label: Compare Entities
modules.query_rule: Use the same canonical entity/profile search packet used by profiles.
modules.calculation_rule: Compare disclosed AUM, country, region, entity type, and profile detail fields from canonical profile packets.
sort_rule: entity name asc by default; user-selected table sort thereafter
modules.duplicate_rule: One comparison row per entity record.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com for unavailable profile fields.
modules.approved_business_logic: Compare rows must not use a separate seed or demo-only entity list.

modules.label: AUM Rankings
modules.query_rule: Return active entities with provenance-bearing USD AUM rows first and source-gap rows at the tail.
modules.calculation_rule: Only rows with positive aum_usd, USD currency, aum_usd_basis, aum_usd_source, and an as-of date enter the dashboard ranking. Sort that comparable prefix by aum_usd descending; never rank or convert source-gap rows in the UI.
modules.empty_state: Render Not disclosed by SWFI.com when AUM or as-of date is not disclosed.
modules.approved_business_logic: Do not infer AUM from unrelated profile text or generated summaries.

modules.label: Source Intelligence / News
modules.data_source: SWFI source intelligence and legacy CMS article records.
modules.query_rule: Return SWFI article rows with title, source URL, and legacy/CMS identifier when disclosed by SWFI.
modules.calculation_rule: Display article facts exactly as returned by the backend packet; legacy source URLs route to SWFIPN research detail pages for preview.
modules.duplicate_rule: One row per SWFI article/source record.
modules.empty_state: Render an empty intelligence table; do not generate article headlines or article dates.
modules.approved_business_logic: No generated, inferred, or fallback article facts may appear as source-backed intelligence.

modules.label: Smart Search
modules.data_source: SWFI public search plus source-backed people and transaction packets.
modules.query_rule: Use the submitted query against approved SWFI search/source endpoints.
modules.calculation_rule: Merge institution, people, and strategy result sets for display; route records internally where possible.
modules.duplicate_rule: The same text query may return different record classes; cross-class duplication is intentional.
modules.empty_state: Show a clean empty/search prompt state.
modules.approved_business_logic: No public-search substitute may override SWFI source packets.

phase_2_items.reason: No approved SWFIPN analytics endpoint or retention policy is currently contracted. Do not add ad-hoc tracking that could capture restricted data.

phase_2_items.criterion: User role permissions are respected for all linked pages.
phase_2_items.reason: Current demo auth is subscriber-session gating, not a full SWFI role/entitlement matrix.
